obligations.expected_behavior: Reject publication when the authorization input is non-empty but forged.
forbidden_result: Publication is accepted with forged authorization.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated forged-auth fixture produces a publication rejection while all other inputs remain constant.
obligations.state_before: A publication attempt has non-empty authorization data that is forged.
obligations.subject: Publication authorization validation
obligations.trigger: A publication attempt is made using forged authorization.

obligations.observable_result: An isolated foreign-state fixture produces a publication rejection while all other inputs remain constant.
obligations.state_before: A publication attempt is made while the lifecycle is in a foreign state.
obligations.subject: Publication lifecycle-state validation
obligations.trigger: A publication attempt is made from a foreign lifecycle state.
